summary: Physics Lab geometry capacity mining found a source-regression gap in the retained geometry/property corpus: generic canonical ObjectGenome placements are asserted to be vertically grounded, but there is no retained invariant that their transformed plan-view envelopes remain inside the room shell or avoid unintended interpenetration with other canonical props/obstacles. The spawn anchor has an explicit inside-shell check and shell/door/stair/ramp relations have dedicated assertions, so a future lateral furniture edit can remain grounded while crossing a wall or another prop without tripping the generic ObjectGenome placement checks. This finding does not assert that the current canonical placements are intersecting; it identifies a missing Reality-Grade normality regression guard.
evidence: Inspected retained geometry/property evidence PR #393 exact head f64f841b25a3fa50203137eff86b48192e70a597. Its generic ObjectGenome loop computes each objectBottom and asserts only that every authored outer envelope is grounded on floorTop.

The same retained test explicitly checks the character spawn anchor is inside the shell and separately checks shell flushness, the door aperture/clearance, stair continuity/rise, ramp bounds, and chair caster/contact properties. No generic object plan-view shell-containment or pairwise object/obstacle non-interpenetration assertion is present in the inspected corpus or its review discussion.

Inspected PhysicsLabRecipe/PhysicsLabRealizer geometry path: authored positions/rotations are converted and realized directly; the source path does not add a general placement-containment/interpenetration validator that would make this test redundant.

A grounded-object-only invariant is independent of lateral placement: changing an object's x/z while preserving its y keeps objectBottom == floorTop, so that class of regression can satisfy the existing generic grounding assertion.

The previously suspected 0.09m door/header top clearance is not reported here because the retained adversary explicitly accepts topClearance <= 0.15m. The known rolling-cart caster grounding/manufacturability lineage is also not duplicated by this finding.

No production code was changed, no executable test was run by this worker, and no Roblox Studio, engine-contact, physical-settling, viewport, diagnostics-capture, or two-client authority evidence is claimed.

metadata.recommendedNext: When the retained Physics geometry test lineage is writable, add a pure deterministic placement guard that transforms each canonical ObjectGenome outer envelope by authored yaw, proves intended props remain within the shell's usable plan-view bounds (with explicit exceptions such as the shell-integrated door), and rejects unintended pairwise prop/obstacle overlap using a conservative OBB/SAT or equally explicit contract. Keep intentional contacts/assemblies allowlisted by semantic key, and add expected-red mutation cases that move a still-grounded prop through a wall and into another prop. Do not substitute this source guard for Roblox Studio contact/settling evidence.
